text:
Priya Shah: Quick ops check for HarborWorks onboarding  p95 creeping to ~390ms over last 36h (target 270ms) and token spend ~+21%. Renewal kickoff in ~5w. Looking for a low-risk runway: small int8 canary on long-context chat + route doc/embedding lookups to compact model. Thoughts?
Jonah Kim: Sounds good. Do we know whether the heavy tail is user-facing chat or background batch jobs?
Priya Shah: Mostly interactive chat/generate. We see many requests with multi-doc fetches and long system prompts. Shared a route heatmap earlier.
Ravi Singh: int8 often helps memory-bound long-contexts. Propose 4% canary to a quantized model for chat gen, and prefix-route any request with meta.doc_refs > 0 to `compact-core-v1` if tagged `best_effort`.
Ana Lopez: From CSM: exclude any billing, legal, or compliance endpoints. They want change-control and a 2hr rollback SLA with contact points.
Priya Shah: OK exclude tags: billing, legal, compliance. Need an ops-safe rollout snippet I can hand to their SREs.
Ravi Singh: Here's a simple policy snippet we use: ```json
{
  "rules": [
    {"endpoint": "/chat/generate", "policy": "canary", "params": {"pct": 4, "model": "harbor-int8-q1", "exclude_tags": ["billing","legal","compliance"]}},
    {"endpoint": "/chat/generate", "policy": "route", "params": {"match": {"meta.doc_refs": {"gt": 0}, "meta.priority": "best_effort"}, "model": "compact-core-v1"}}
  ]
}
```
Jonah Kim: @ops-bot please run a perf-smoke comparing harbor-int8-q1 vs harbor-fp16 on 500 anonymized onboarding traces. Capture p50/p95/p99, token-cost delta, and a quality diff on our anchor prompts.
ops-bot: Scheduled job #41288: perf-smoke/harbor-int8. Samples: 500. ETA ~40m. I will post results to this thread.
Ana Lopez: Add quality gate: if eval-suite avg drops >3% or hallucination rate increases >2x, auto-rollback. Also capture exact-match rate for top-10 intents.
Ravi Singh: Gate command: `eval-suite run --customer harborworks --suite onboarding-anchor --min-avg 0.965` 1fail triggers rollback.
ops-bot: perf-smoke/41288 complete summary: p95 -15%, p99 -9%, token cost per request -13.2%. Eval-suite avg = 96.8% on onboarding-anchor. Full logs: https://ci.redwood/smoke/41288
Priya Shah: Nice — meets latency and cost targets. Proposed ramp: 24h @4% -> 24h @25% for `best_effort` docs -> 48h @50% global, with auto-rollback rules. Coordinate with their SRE for a 2h low-traffic window before bumping to 25%.
Jonah Kim: Also capture a brief ops quote after 25% step for the renewal deck and update the customer-facing note with expected cost savings (-~13%) and p95 improvement.
Ana Lopez: I'll collect SRE contacts and confirm the exclusion list. Also ask for a quick ops-runbook acceptance sign-off.
Ravi Singh: I'll prepare a rollback playbook (CLI steps to flip routing, revoke model alias, and a small checklist: watch p95/p99, error rate, divergence metrics).
Priya Shah: Action items: Priya -> coordinate SRE window & comms; Jonah -> renewal slide bullets & before/after numbers; Ravi -> rollback/playbook; Ana -> get SRE signoff and collect quote.
Jonah Kim: Noted. I'll draft renewal bullets and drop in ~2h.
Priya Shah: Thanks team. Will post the enablement doc link and the SRE snippet once the window is scheduled. :sparkles:
